resources.string:
1. Choose an AI provider, paste its API key below and tap Save.

WhatsApp, Gmail and most apps:
Type your message → select it → tap "Make Professional" (it may be under ⋮) → Replace.

WeChat:
Type your message → select it → Copy → pull down quick settings → tap "Pro Writer" → long-press the message box → Paste.
Always write the result in English

Add the \"Pro Writer\" tile to your quick settings (the panel you pull down from the top of the screen). In WeChat: select your message → Copy → tap the tile → the professional version is copied for you → long-press the message box → Paste.\n\nYou can also long-press the Pro Writer app icon and choose \"Polish copied text\".
Pull down quick settings, tap the pencil (edit) icon, and drag \"Pro Writer\" into your tiles.
Tile added. Pull down quick settings to find \"Pro Writer\".
The Pro Writer tile is already in your quick settings.
Nothing copied yet. Select your message, tap Copy, then tap the Pro Writer tile again.
✓ Copied. Long-press the message box and tap Paste.
Type a message, e.g. \"hi sir i cant come tomorow my bike is not working\"
